_comment: Cases for scripts/check-rules.mjs. Kept as JSON, not .ts, so the script's own scan of src/ never sees these deliberate violations. Each case is written into a temporary tree and the script runs on it; `expect` is the rule reported at line 1 of `file`, or null for a clean run; `others` holds further files for checks that follow imports.
